scoring_justification: T1: the checker recomputes the fraction of alloys whose gamma_DFT and gamma_th are within absolute tolerance of the paper's reported values, directly from the agent's submitted CSV rows.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold gamma_DFT and gamma_th values per alloy from Table 1 (non-magnetic)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1, columns gamma_DFT and gamma_th, non-magnetic rows for 11 equimolar alloys
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted manually from the published paper (Acta Materialia 2018) Table 1, non-magnetic rows
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported values for the same quantities, same conditions (non-spin-polarized DFT). They serve as the hidden reference for scoring.

outputs.description: CSV containing the final DFT-computed and analytically-predicted quantities for all 11 equimolar FCC alloys.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's reported gamma_DFT and gamma_th for each alloy against the paper-reported gold values (non-magnetic, Table 1) using per-quantity tolerances. The reward is the fraction of alloys for which both gamma_DFT and gamma_th match within tolerance. Additional columns (lattice constants, elastic constants) are required for completeness but carry no separate scoring weight.
